title: Providence bundle-directory manifest
description: manifest.json for the directory form of a Providence bundle -- see SPEC.md. Documentation only; providence/check.py validates by hand rather than importing a jsonschema dependency for this.

tool.description: Which tool produced this bundle, e.g. 'invariant', 'receipt'.

id.description: Unique within this manifest. Evidence lives at '<id>.json' beside manifest.json.

sha256.description: sha256 of the exact bytes of '<id>.json'.
